description: The RUN step (step 6) of an open engagement — work the governed, deterministic earned → settled → open accrual across the engagement's active agreements and certified data. Do NOT call this as the first thing when a user says 'compute the close': a firm opens the engagement first (open_engagement), establishes the agreement, requests + certifies the data, and only then runs. If no engagement is open, this refuses and leads back to open_engagement. You get back the number, how earned / claimed / credited line up, and any flag worth raising. Nothing posts to the GL; the number is prepared for approval. Requires a connected Aurgus account.
name: compute_close
